name: plan-only-payload-shape
title: Plan-only and executed local-review reports have divergent payload shapes
description: sd-ai-command-pack-review-local.py emits two structurally different payloads under one command name: --plan-only puts plan at the JSON root, while an executed run nests everything under .receipt. Consumers cannot dispatch on shape, and jq paths written for one silently return null against the other.
creator: sdelmas
